materialFindings.before: Known summary aliases were accepted as legacy summary intent but Revise the summary / Revise the factual paragraph with Notes selected, and Revise my notes with Summary selected, did not trigger clarification.
materialFindings.resolution: Owner added revise and factual paragraph aliases to existing narrow action/preservation checks. Re-read current helper and pure invocation now rejects all four explicit opposite-section cases.
materialFindings.scope: Known literal vocabulary only; no complete natural-language/negation classifier claim.

checks.finding: Intent remains verbatim goal.request/request.intent; explicit target is separate validated union. Notes target binds paragraph index/hash and server derives current offset/range. Request identity reconciliation compares target and clarified format as well as intent/labels. No client-selected file/version paths.

Original-v0 ambiguous unlabelled/unselected request fails hasLegacySummaryIntent before child creation; current-version missing target requires explicit old summary contract or new target. Valid explicit summary clarification synthesizes its format requirements separately without replacing original intent. UI onChange only saves draft; explicit Save starts work. Named contradictory section/preservation clauses now reject in prepare and orchestrator.

checks.area: Exact note splice and approval identity
checks.finding: noteSnapshot derives exact current paragraph and whole-notes hash; noteProposal splices exact native text into unchanged prefix/suffix, no host prose repair. proposalHash for notes binds target, unchanged summary and complete proposedNotes. stateFrom reconstructs raw->noteProposal and rejects changed target, replacement or other-note bytes. Summary targets reject any notesEdit/notesReview metadata.

checks.area: Current notes versus original provenance and future edits
checks.finding: currentNotes uses input.base.notes or immutable original input. acceptedNotes uses accepted note output or preserved effective notes. New child checkpoints pin effective notes when parent/ancestry contains a notes edit; verifyBase compares them recursively. Original brief/source snapshot remains separately immutable. Future summary edits inherit accepted note changes instead of restoring original notes.

checks.area: Literal guards versus optimistic native review
checks.finding: Execute recomputes current check before accepting native support; Apply recomputes it before approval regardless of previous positive draft/review flags. Punctuation/case or deletion-only changes are rejected; literal before/future/completed-claim/new-URL guards remain bounded. All supported/meaning/planned/no-completion/clarity flags must be true. These guards and same-model review do not prove semantic accuracy.

Raw writer saved before projection/checks; invalid shape/error retains original raw and failure reason. Raw note review is separately saved/hashed before validating it; invalid/rejected review remains inspectable. Rejected proposals retain exact before/proposed/range/native JSON and Continue reuses existing raw rather than regenerating accepted/saved decisions.

checks.area: Abort, stale base, locks and conditional publication
checks.finding: Create and Apply share document lock; execution waits abortably on same lock to avoid synchronous-kick reentry failure. Stop stays immediate; approval re-reads goal after async verification. Execute checks abort after prepublication verify and PDF read, before global target copy/SQL. Version publication is conditional on base revision/owned operation and unknown paths are not overwritten. Stale conflicts preserve raw/selection/proposal and do not silently rebase.

Read-only invocation of real current plan() over actual accepted v1/v2 inputs/states reproduces HTML and full provenance byte-for-byte. No store constructor/database/service/model used. Renderer and default model transport files remain exact dc1885c bytes.

Child source audit found no blocker in explicit blank choices, stale hash preservation, unsent/submitted distinction, rendered note comparison/raw diff, rejected/raw/review inspection or modal/Cancel/focus assumptions. Actual browser focus/touch/layout remains owner evidence.

ownerGateEvidence.scope: Root-reported substantive gate before bounded literal alias fix; alias focused gate separate. Not run by this reviewer.

limitations: Static source/readonly pure-function and historical-plan evaluation only; no repository edits, test suite/browser/native generation/service/DB mutations performed during this source-review phase. Earlier10 authorized prompt diagnostics are separately recorded failures.

Actual current NOTE role and normal-server desktop/short-phone selection->clarification->review->Apply->export user goal have not been accepted by this review. Driver must honestly decide achieved/blocked/failed; native quality cannot be inferred from guards or fixture tests.
Literal mismatch/meaning checks are deliberately narrow and native meaning review is fallible. No arbitrary PDF/general semantic accuracy/voice/physical handset claim.
